name: tool-discipline
description: PreToolUse guardrails that steer the agent toward the right tool: block cd-chaining in Bash (run with absolute paths), prefer built-in Read/Write/Edit over cat/head/tail/sed, and (conditionally) redirect ToolSearch loads of Grep/Glob to the embedded ripgrep/ugrep/bfs Bash search on native builds that dropped those tools — self-disabling where Grep/Glob still ship
